instruction: Close the Chrome browser, then reopen it and navigate to https://github.com.

args.query: title = 'attachment' and 'root' in parents and trashed = false

metadata.explanation: Task requires closing Chrome browser and reopening it with github.com. Evaluator uses existing is_expected_tabs metric to verify github.com tab is open.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator only verifies partial instruction completion (github.com navigation) but not the close/reopen requirement
False positives possible - task passes even if Chrome was never closed/reopened
The evaluator cannot distinguish between 'opened github.com in existing session' vs 'closed browser, reopened, then navigated to github.com'
Instruction has 3 steps (close, reopen, navigate) but evaluator only checks final step (presence of github.com tab)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Simplify instruction to just 'Navigate to https://github.com in Chrome' (removing close/reopen requirement to match what evaluator actually checks)
Or add verification that Chrome was actually restarted (e.g., check that initial tabs from config are no longer present, only github.com tab exists)
Or split into multiple verification steps: check Chrome process was terminated, then restarted, then github.com is open
Consider using a different getter that can detect Chrome restart events or session changes
